data.name: Pradip Thite
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Pradip Thite has made a big mark in cricket. With 79 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 68*, with an average of 30.89 and a quick strike rate of 151.16. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 58 sixes and 169 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 65.2 overs, taking 38 wickets at an economy rate of 9.08. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
